PRST.description: Prestress Loads (PRST). Keyed by element number; each element carries a list of ITEMS, one prestress (tension) load per entry, tied to a static load case (LCNAME) and optional load group (GROUP_NAME).

ITEMS.description: List of prestress load entries applied to this element. Each entry is one tension load definition.

ID.description: Serial number of the load entry within this element. Multiple entries with distinct IDs may exist per element.

LCNAME.description: Static load case name. Must match an existing static load case; otherwise the request is rejected.

GROUP_NAME.description: Load group name. If non-empty it must match an existing load group; empty means no group.

DIR.description: Prestress direction code (element local axis). 0 = local y, 1 = local z.

DISTANCE_I.description: Eccentricity/offset distance at the I-end of the element.

DISTANCE_M.description: Eccentricity/offset distance at the mid (M) point of the element.

DISTANCE_J.description: Eccentricity/offset distance at the J-end of the element.
